_doc: The mod ledger's one config (modledger.py; spec design/specs/2026-11-15-holder-pipeline-fusion.md §3, item RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_MOD_LEDGER_HOLDERS_THREE_PILOTS_AT_ONCE). Every number the holder-pipeline fusion runs on lives here and nowhere else. holder_context_ceiling_tokens: his card 2026-11-15, 'Try 400k first.' (the holder rotates at its next natural boundary past it). packet_budget_tokens: the spec's 15k packet bound (tokens = bytes/4). lease_idle_minutes: a holder lease lapses after this long with no lease or holder event (a starting number, borrowed from the bridge rule). writers: which event kinds each writer class may append; a finder (JUDGE, STEWARD, OWNER) writes finding.open with the precise fix it would make (his card 2026-11-15: 'Anyone finding anything documents precisely how they would fix it but it goes back to the holder fully informed.'); only a JUDGE turns a finding green. packet_line_chars: one text in the packet past this many characters is clipped with a pointer to the command that prints it whole (fulltext.clip); the ledger keeps it whole. backfill_item_words: per mod, the item-name words that alone mark a live rimflow item as that mod's at backfill (an item naming the mod in its name or opening lines needs none); a short word is listed only where it names nothing else.
